    Abilities & builds

    Change hero

    Controls

    Left click / drag
    Click to inspect or select a unit. Drag a box to select your hero and summons inside it.
    F1 / F2
    Select and recenter on your hero, or select all units you control. Use Z or X if the browser captures these keys.
    Right click
    Move or attack with the selected units. Your hero can draw creep aggro by targeting a hero, or deny weakened allied creeps.
    C / Space
    Press C to toggle free camera, or Space to recenter without changing selection. Click or drag the minimap to look around from either mode. In free camera, you can also pan with the screen edges, arrow keys, or middle-mouse drag.
    Q W E R
    Select a targeted ability, then click the battlefield to cast. Right-click or Esc cancels. Self-casts and Cairn's directional blasts trigger immediately.
    A / S
    Attack the target or attack-move to the cursor / stop and hold fire.
    1 through 6
    Activate the item in that inventory slot.
    B T
    Open the item shop or recall to your fountain.
    P / Esc
    Pause solo play.
    `
    Show or hide both teams, including hero levels and equipment.
    G / M
    Cycle graphics quality / toggle sound.
    Neris spell recipes

    Choose three marks with Q, W, or E in any order. Press R to prepare the spell, then D or F to cast.

    Last-hit enemy creeps for gold. Destroy the outer tower, inner tower, and enemy core in order.
